reason: I already pay for POS, accounting and the delivery apps eat my margin, and I raised prices twice this year. Another 25 a month plus VAT, every month, just so I don't have to touch the menu myself? I can update Google hours on my phone for free.
objection: If I stop paying, what happens to the site and the address people know? The domain is only mine on the 40 euro plan, so on 25 I'd be building on someone else's land and lose it the day I cancel.
would_change_my_mind: Own domain and a full export of my site and menu included even on the cheap plan, so I keep everything if I cancel, and a free first month to see if it actually saves me time.
